gotchas: FusedLocationProviderClient.getCurrentLocation lacks an internal timeout when GPS hardware is off, hanging coroutines indefinitely without withTimeoutOrNull
Android 14 crashes with SecurityException if startForeground(FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_LOCATION) is called without ACCESS_FINE/COARSE_LOCATION; fallback to DATA_SYNC
On Android 13+ (API 33+), foreground notifications are silently dropped unless Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS is requested at runtime
Receiving HTTP 429 without checking isGlobalRateLimited() prior to subsequent requests will continue hitting endpoints and lengthen IP blocks
Launching coroutines on every onVerticalDrag delta frame creates hundreds of instances and GC churn; mutate state directly or use continuous pointerInput
Calling LocationService.startLocationUpdates repeatedly without stopping old instances leaks FusedLocationClient listeners and drains battery rapidly
Mapping all 50 HERE EV stations into domain models every 5 seconds creates severe GC churn; filter raw HereEvStation list first
Reading animation float state in a root composable body triggers 60-120fps recomposition storm; always isolate in dedicated Composable
evcs.vn /media endpoint blocks requests with Cloudflare 403; decode double base64 to cpo-prod-s3.vinfastauto.com direct URL instead
